# MAV Grid

> An open, parametric dovetail-groove grid and face-plate standard.

MAV Grid defines a 32 mm grid of swappable face plates separated by 14 degree dovetail grooves (8.0 mm opening; Small 6.0 mm deep, Large 9.5 mm deep). This repository holds the specification, its schema, and a Python toolkit of parameterized CAD generators, plates, adapters and exporters.

## Primary Documentation Links
- [Documentation Home](https://markurtz.github.io/mav-grid/): Main site home page
- [Specification](https://markurtz.github.io/mav-grid/specification/): Status, decided values and conventions
- [Getting Started](https://markurtz.github.io/mav-grid/getting-started/): Installation and first commands
- [Guides](https://markurtz.github.io/mav-grid/guides/): Generating parts, changing parameters, plates and adapters, repository layout and CI/CD
- [API Reference](https://markurtz.github.io/mav-grid/reference/): CLI and Python API reference

## Architectural Topography

### Configuration & Entrypoints
- [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml): Project settings, Hatch environments and scripts.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent development guidelines, build commands and boundaries.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Pointer to `AGENTS.md`.
- [src/mav_grid/__main__.py](src/mav_grid/__main__.py): `mav-grid` CLI entrypoint.

### Specification
- [spec/README.md](spec/README.md): Specification status, layout and conventions.
- [spec/mav-grid-spec.md](spec/mav-grid-spec.md): Text of the 0.11 draft, with rule IDs.
- [spec/data/params.json](spec/data/params.json): Every constant, limit, thread, fixing, reference key and gauge.
- [spec/data/](spec/data/): Plate kinds, support register, rules, decisions, tests and test vectors.
- [spec/examples/](spec/examples/): Valid and invalid claim records.
- [spec/CHANGELOG.md](spec/CHANGELOG.md): Specification changes by version.
- [spec/schema/](spec/schema/): Normative JSON Schema 2020-12 files, written by hand.
- [samples/](samples/): Sample claim records, written by `scripts/make_samples.py`.

### Core Python Modules
- [src/mav_grid/__init__.py](src/mav_grid/__init__.py): Package initialization and public API.
- [src/mav_grid/spec.py](src/mav_grid/spec.py): Targeted specification version, schema address and licence expressions.
- [src/mav_grid/settings.py](src/mav_grid/settings.py): Pydantic settings.
- [src/mav_grid/logging.py](src/mav_grid/logging.py): Loguru logging setup.
- [src/mav_grid/schema/](src/mav_grid/schema/): Spec file loading, validation, typed parameters and records, formulas, rule checker.
- [src/mav_grid/geometry/](src/mav_grid/geometry/): Kernel-free shapes and plans, and the optional build123d kernel.
- [src/mav_grid/generators/](src/mav_grid/generators/): Grid faces, folds, plates, keys, gauges; panel, corner, column and box records.
- [src/mav_grid/plates/](src/mav_grid/plates/): One drawing function per plate kind.
- [src/mav_grid/adapters/](src/mav_grid/adapters/): Adapters to other systems, modelled from scratch.
- [src/mav_grid/export/](src/mav_grid/export/): STEP, STL, 3MF, GLB, SVG and DXF writers and the release folder.

### Testing Suite Tiers
- [tests/python/unit/](tests/python/unit/): Python unit tests.
- [tests/python/integration/](tests/python/integration/): Python integration tests, including spec file consistency, samples and CAD builds.
- [tests/e2e/](tests/e2e/): End-to-end tests against the installed package.
- [examples/](examples/): Runnable examples, each with its own test.
